title: Dactyl Rust Contract release-proof fix
intent: Fix the Rust Contract workflow regression introduced by the v0.8.1 release by deriving the release assertion from the package metadata, preserving host SQLite runtime proof, and publishing one dedicated PR.
proof_hooks: cargo fmt --all -- --check; cargo test --all-features with explicit host SQLite; cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings; decapod validate
stop_conditions: No bundled SQLite, rusqlite, libsqlite3-sys, public backend handle, or silent snapshot fallback.
